title: Finance Manager
description:
Finance Manager

Location: Fully Remote (LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time


Strong financial operations don’t just track performance, they drive it. We’re looking for a Finance Manager who can take ownership of our accounting and financial processes, improve reporting speed and accuracy, and support operational decision-making as we scale.


About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, performance-driven consumer brand built for pet owners. We operate across ecommerce and retail, and our finance function plays a critical role in enabling smart, data-driven growth.

We believe finance should be proactive, structured, and tightly connected to operations. That’s where you come in.


The Role

This is an ownership role. You will manage the full accounting cycle, oversee financial reporting, and ensure accuracy across all financial operations.

You will work closely with the VP of Operations and play a key role in improving processes, shortening close cycles, and building a scalable finance function.

This is not a purely back-office role, you’ll be expected to think analytically, identify inefficiencies, and actively improve how we operate.


This Role Is For You If:

  • You think in systems and processes, not just tasks
  • You are detail-oriented and highly organized
  • You are comfortable owning the full accounting cycle
  • You enjoy improving workflows and increasing efficiency
  • You can balance accuracy with speed in a fast-paced environment


This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You prefer narrowly defined tasks without ownership
  • You struggle with deadlines or process improvement
  • You are not comfortable working in a high-growth environment


What You'll Do

Accounting & Financial Operations

  • Own the full accounting cycle, including month-end close
  • Prepare financial statements and reports
  • Ensure accuracy and compliance across financial records

Month-End Close & Process Improvement

  • Reduce month-end close timeline from 5 days to 3 days
  • Identify inefficiencies and improve accounting workflows
  • Build scalable processes and documentation

Team Oversight

  • Manage and oversee the bookkeeping team and AP clerk
  • Ensure quality, accuracy, and timeliness of work

Cost & Inventory Accounting

  • Manage and apply landed costs across products
  • Ensure accurate cost tracking and margin visibility

Reporting & Analysis

  • Provide financial insights and analysis to support decision-making
  • Work closely with the VP of Operations on performance tracking


Requirements

Must have:

  • 1+ year of experience in ecommerce or DTC
  • Experience managing full accounting cycle and financial reporting
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • High attention to detail and organization

Work Requirements

⏰ Schedule: Flexble

Workspace: Fixed, professional setup required (stable internet + backup plan)


Benefits & Compensation

  • Fully remote
  • Paid time off
  • Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire
  • Ownership & autonomy - trusted to build and execute strategy


Ready to Apply?

If you want to build and scale a high-performing finance function, apply now.

Experiência com Python aplicado a análise e visualização de dados.


Conhecimento em frameworks de visualização interativa como Streamlit.


Experiência com construção de produtos de dados além de dashboards (apps analíticos, data products).


Vivência com grandes volumes de dados e ambientes distribuídos.

title: Specialist AI Engineer / Builder (LLM & Healthcare) | Remote Job
description:
The Challenge

Every year, the healthcare industry loses billions due to billing failures. We are building the missing link that closes this gap with AI.

We are growing fast, with real operations, active customers, and new partners in the pipeline. We are looking for a builder who wants to help turn our current product into a platform with global scale.


Why This Role Might Be for You

Here, autonomy, ownership, and initiative are part of the daily routine. We are not looking for someone who already knows everything. Not knowing is part of the process. What matters to us is investigative curiosity, strong execution, and a genuine desire to learn.

You will work across both execution and strategy: from writing code to helping shape product and technical decisions. This is a role for someone who can propose new models, spot revenue opportunities, and also dig into data manually when needed to make sure the solution is truly accurate.

Speed, urgency, and attention to detail are essential to how we build.


Key Responsibilities

Your mission will be to help lead the evolution of our AI capabilities.

Today: Execution and Precision

  • Refine and optimize models already in production using AWS Bedrock, continuously improving accuracy and performance.
  • Validate data, rules, and outputs manually when needed. In healthcare, data quality is non-negotiable.
  • Monitor denial patterns and implement fast feedback loops so the system improves continuously.

Tomorrow: Scale and Architecture

  • Help evolve our infrastructure into a robust ecosystem using RAG pipelines and vector databases.
  • Move from a centralized AI solution toward a network of specialized models by context and insurance payer.
  • Contribute to fine-tuning proprietary models using our historical data to create a unique competitive advantage.


What We’re Looking For

  • Investigative curiosity: You want to understand complex medical billing rules and are motivated to master a difficult domain. Healthcare experience is not required.
  • Bias for action: You move fast, take initiative, and understand that speed matters in an early-stage company.
  • Hands-on coding ability: Solid practical experience with Python or Go, plus experience working with LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or AWS Bedrock.
  • Builder mindset: You enjoy creating robust systems from scratch and care deeply about precision, reliability, and business impact.


What We Offer

  • Early-stage impact: Be one of the early team members in a fast-growing company and help shape both the architecture and the culture.
  • High-level technical challenge: Work on real business problems using modern generative AI.
  • Strong team: Work with ambitious, high-performing people who care about building something meaningful.
  • Remote flexibility: 100% remote work, open to candidates based in Brazil.
  • Long-term upside: Potential equity participation for people who help build the business with us.
  • Legacy: Your work will leave a real mark on the product, the codebase, and the company’s story.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

title: Paid Ads QA Auditor - Global
description:
Are you obsessive about catching what others miss?


Do you notice inconsistencies without being told where to look?


Do you get satisfaction from identifying errors before they become problems?


Final question: when faced with a challenge, do you get excited or run away?


If that sounds like you, you may be the perfect fit for our Paid Ads QA role.


At Crisp, we're on a mission to help 10,000 law firms each grow their revenue by $10,000,000 over the next 10 years, creating a $10 billion impact in the legal industry.


Our Paid Ads team is responsible for executing paid media campaigns that power our law firm clients’ brand awareness and growth across major digital platforms. These campaigns are deployed across hundreds of client accounts and multiple platforms simultaneously.


This role exists to ensure those campaigns are executed accurately, consistently, and in alignment with internal standards and client intent.


This is a non-client-facing, audit-focused role that requires extreme attention to detail, strong system thinking, and the discipline to identify and document discrepancies with zero tolerance for preventable error.


However, it is not a “task-ing” role, or a role where you’ll be constantly told what to do - you’ll be expected to self-sufficiently spot and correct errors, but most importantly, get ahead of them before even happening, including improving existing systems.


** IMPORTANT: TO APPLY **

You will be evaluated and vetted based on your ability to follow instructions:

Follow this Willo link (recorded interview platform), and answer the few questions on there, first.Then reply to the ad, stating you’ve completed the Willo, and we will be in touch.


Key Responsibilities Include:


Campaign Audit & Validation

  • Audit paid advertising campaigns across Meta, Google Ads, LinkedIn, TikTok, streaming platforms, and others
  • Verify that the correct creative assets, ad copy, and campaign structures are deployed on the correct client accounts
  • Ensure campaigns align with intended funnel stages and approved execution parameters


Execution Accuracy & Cross-Account Integrity

  • Identify discrepancies such as:
  • Incorrect assets deployed to the wrong client
  • Mismatched ad copy or campaign configurations
  • Inconsistent implementation across platforms
  • Ensure campaign execution matches internal direction and client-specific setup


Budget & Pacing Verification

  • Audit campaign budgets to ensure alignment with approved allocations
  • Identify risks of underdelivery or overspend
  • Validate that budget adjustments and reallocations are executed correctly


Tracking, Links & Technical QA

  • Verify accuracy and functionality of:
  • URLs and landing pages
  • UTM parameters and tracking links
  • Pixel and tag implementation (where applicable)
  • Identify gaps in tracking integrity and flag inconsistencies


Instruction Fidelity & Change Validation

  • Compare campaign execution against:
  • Internal strategy direction
  • Client Success Manager requests
  • Campaign updates or pivots
  • Ensure requested changes are implemented accurately and completely


Audit Documentation & Communication

  • Document audit findings clearly, with supporting context and evidence
  • Categorize issues based on severity (e.g., minor discrepancy vs. critical error)
  • Communicate findings in a structured format that enables efficient resolution


Audit Operations (Evolving Scope)


This role may operate across a range of audit models depending on business needs, including:

Audit Cadence:

  • Pre-launch validation
  • Post-launch verification
  • Ongoing daily, weekly, or periodic audits

Audit Coverage:

  • Full account audits
  • Targeted sampling across accounts

Audit Depth:

  • Surface-level validation (assets, placements, links)
  • Deeper audits (budget pacing, tracking, structural accuracy)

Ownership Scope:

  • Identifying and flagging discrepancies
  • Recommending corrective actions
  • Supporting enforcement of quality standards


Our requirements are pretty straightforward. To qualify you must:

  • Be highly detail-oriented — you catch inconsistencies others miss
  • Think in structured processes, checklists, and systems
  • Be proactive in identifying issues and asking clarifying questions
  • Be comfortable operating with incomplete information and making sound judgments
  • Have strong written communication skills
  • Be tech-savvy and able to learn new platforms quickly
  • Be comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-volume environment


Preferred Experience:

  • Experience auditing or QA-ing digital campaigns (launches, changes, tracking)
  • Familiarity with UTM structures, tracking links, and link verification
  • Experience working with dashboards or reporting tools
  • Experience using project management or task tracking tools (Asana, Monday, etc.)


Nice to Have:

  • Salesforce or CRM familiarity
  • Experience with Supermetrics or similar data connectors
  • Familiarity with Google Looker Studio or similar dashboards
  • Experience documenting processes or building SOPs
  • Experience in a fast-paced, multi-client environment


Platform Exposure (Preferred, Not Required):

  • Meta Ads Manager
  • Google Ads
  • Google Tag Manager (GTM)
  • TikTok Ads
  • LinkedIn Ads
  • TradeDesk


Why Our Work Matters:


Lawyers go to law school to learn how to practice law, but law school doesn’t teach them how to run a business. In a world where the best cases often go to the best marketers, legal expertise alone isn’t enough.


That’s where Crisp comes in.


We partner with committed, growth-minded law firms that care deeply about their teams, clients, and communities. Often, it’s a David vs. Goliath scenario, where the most dedicated attorneys lack the resources of their larger competitors.


Our work levels the playing field by giving law firms access to world-class marketing execution that helps them stand out, build authority, and grow sustainably.


About Crisp:

Crisp has been recognized on the Inc. 5000 (Fastest Growing Private Companies in the U.S. – 2024, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017), as well as Atlanta's Top 100 Fastest Growing Private Companies (2025, 2024, 2023, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017, 2016) and Atlanta's Best Places to Work (2024, 2023, 2022).


Crisp ( is the nation’s fastest-growing law firm growth company. We’ve helped thousands of attorneys — from solo and small firms to large practices — build their brand, differentiate themselves from competitors, attract better cases, and earn millions in new revenue.

Crisp has been featured in Forbes, Inc., Avvo, ABA Journal, The Trial Lawyer, Huffington Post, and The Wall Street Journal.


OUR BOOK:

The Game Changing Attorney (available on Amazon and Barnes & Noble)


OUR PODCAST:

The Game Changing Attorney Podcast


Why You Should Work Here:

  • You will work inside a structured, high-performance marketing operation
  • You will contribute to campaigns running at scale across hundreds of accounts
  • You will play a direct role in improving execution accuracy and system reliability
  • You will be trusted to identify and surface critical issues


This is not a role for someone looking for easy work or vague expectations.

This is a role for someone who takes pride in enforcing standards, identifying errors, and ensuring systems operate correctly.

title: Creative Producer
description:
AI Creative Producer

About Us

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. With a global audience of over 200 million listeners, we are redefining entertainment through episodic audio storytelling across diverse genres. We are seeking a highly organized and creative Creative Producer to manage and oversee the end-to-end production of high-quality audio content.

Role Overview

As a Creative Producer , you will play a key role in managing the end-to-end production process of audio content across various formats on Pocket FM. You will collaborate closely with writers, voice artists, creators, and production teams to ensure timely delivery of high-quality episodes. The role requires strong operational management, creative oversight, and the ability to coordinate across multiple stakeholders to deliver compelling audio experiences for our listeners.



Key Responsibilities

1. AI Voice Evaluation & Platform Coordination

Evaluate and benchmark AI-generated voices across platforms, maintaining a curated repository of approved voices. Continuously assess new features, tools, and model updates to enhance voice quality. Partner with product and AI voice platform teams to optimize voice solutions (including language-specific improvements such as Spanish).

2. Production Planning & Pipeline Management

Work with content and production teams to plan episode pipelines, forecast deliverables, and ensure timely execution of projects. Maintain visibility on production timelines and proactively address bottlenecks.

3. Stakeholder Collaboration

Coordinate with cross-functional teams including Content, Editorial, Marketing, Product, and Quality Control to ensure alignment on production goals, timelines, and quality standards. Share learnings and best practices across teams and geographies.

4. Production Quality Oversight

Partner with the QC team to review and approve episodes, ensuring adherence to quality benchmarks and creative intent. Identify and resolve issues related to voice quality, narration, sound design, and technical consistency prior to release.

5. Audience Feedback Monitoring & Optimization

Monitor listener feedback, user comments, and performance metrics to identify areas of improvement in content quality and engagement. Collaborate with relevant teams to implement enhancements and optimize the overall listening experience.

6. Process & Workflow Optimization

Continuously improve production workflows, creator management practices, and operational efficiency. Document processes, guidelines, and best practices to enable consistent and scalable content production.

7. Deliverables & Performance Expectations

Ensure timely delivery of all assigned episodes in line with targets. Drive structured coordination across stakeholders, resulting in high-quality, QC-approved audio content. Contribute to process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-team collaboration.



Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in content production, creator management, or media production.
  • Strong understanding of audio storytelling, podcast production, or audiobook production workflows .
  • Proven experience working with creators, voice artists, or creative production teams.
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple workstreams.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Ability to work in fast-paced environments and handle high-volume content production.
  • Self-motivated with strong problem-solving abilities and a proactive mindset.

  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em cardiologia.

Médico competente em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com problemas de saúde cardiológicos .

title: Sr. AI Engineer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $5,000 - $6,500 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking an engineer who takes prototypes to production: hardening, deploying, iterating with real users, and owning the full delivery pipeline. You’re the person who makes AI products real.


The role:

They have prototypes that work. What they don’t have is a dedicated engineer to take them to production. You’ll take existing foundations, harden them into production-grade applications, deploy them, and iterate based on real user feedback. You’ll also prototype new AI-powered features and capabilities alongside your director.


This is an engineering execution role, not a product management role. You’ll make technical decisions about AI behavior, implement LLM tool-use flows for non-technical hotel operators, and own the entire delivery pipeline from working prototype to deployed, monitored, production application.


What you’ll do:

  • Take prototypes to production. The prototypes exist a conversational BI tool with NL2SQL and a portfolio-level operations dashboard. You’ll add auth, monitoring, error handling, test coverage, and deploy them for real users.
  • Own AI engineering decisions. Implement how the LLM interacts with users tool-use flows, NL2SQL generation, streaming UX, error recovery, conversation lifecycle. You have opinions about this, not just implementation skills.
  • Build full-stack. Angular 19/21, Fastify 5, TypeScript end-to-end. Frontend components, API routes, Snowflake queries you move across the stack as needed.
  • Harden and deploy. CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps), Azure AD authentication, error handling, test coverage, performance optimization. Make prototypes production-safe.
  • Close the loop with stakeholders. Work with their director and the product team to translate user feedback into engineering iterations. You won’t be customer-facing, but you’ll be close to the feedback and responsible for acting on it.
  • Manage and extend the verified query set. Their NL2SQL accuracy is powered by example-led generation a curated library of verified queries that constrain LLM output. You’ll add to it, run gap analyses, and use it as the primary lever for improving answer accuracy.
  • Close the feedback loop. User signals acknowledgments, ratings, corrections feed back into system quality. You’ll design pipelines that route those signals to verified query sets, prompt refinement, or evaluation frameworks so the system improves measurably with use.
  • Work with AI agents. Their development workflow uses Claude Code with specialist AI agents, CLAUDE.md-driven conventions, and Design → Build → Review pipelines. You’ll adopt and improve this system.


Tech you’ll work with:

  • Application layer: TypeScript, Angular 19/21, Fastify 5, Node.js, React
  • Monorepo and standalone app structures. SSE streaming, Zustand/NgRx state management, ECharts, Material UI.
  • AI / LLM integration: Gemini (Vertex AI), Claude API, Tool-use patterns, SSE streaming, MCP (Model Context Protocol)
  • Text-to-Specification patterns the LLM classifies and parameterizes against a semantic layer rather than writing raw SQL. dbt semantic layer for metric definitions and dimension catalogs. MCP server architecture serving data retrieval across multiple products.
  • Data layer: Snowflake, dbt, Data Vault 2.0
  • You don’t need to be a data engineer, but you’ll write Snowflake queries and understand the Data Vault model backing their analytics.
  • Infrastructure: Azure, Azure DevOps, Azure AD
  • CI/CD pipelines, cloud hosting, SSO authentication. You’ll own the path from merged PR to running in production.


What they’re looking for:

Must-haves

  • AI engineering experience. You’ve built and shipped applications that use LLMs not just wrappers around ChatGPT, but real tool-use flows, structured generation, or agent systems.
  • You have opinions about when to stream vs. batch, when to ask for clarification vs. infer, and how to handle LLM errors gracefully.
  • Full-stack TypeScript. Strong in Angular (their primary customer-facing framework). React experience is a plus but Angular is the requirement. Solid Node.js/Fastify backend skills. You can own a feature from database query to rendered UI.
  • Production shipping muscle. You’ve taken something from “it works on my machine” to “it’s running in production with real users.” CI/CD, monitoring, auth, error handling the foundational work that makes software real.
  • Direct communication. You ask questions before building. You push back on vague requirements. You say “this seems wrong” when it does. No yes-people.
  • AI agent systems experience. You’ve built, managed, or worked extensively with AI agent systems multi-agent orchestration, tool-use pipelines, or agentic development workflows. Their entire dev process runs through 30+ specialist AI agents; you need to be comfortable operating in and improving that system.
  • AI-assisted development. Comfortable working with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, etc.) as a core part of your workflow, not a novelty.
  • Multi-tenant AI safety. You understand the difference between enforcing data isolation at the LLM layer (fragile) versus the data connection layer (robust) and why that distinction matters when customer data can never cross boundaries.


Nice-to-haves:

  • Hospitality industry experience or multi-property portfolio analytics
  • Snowflake / SQL analytics experience
  • Experience with SSE or WebSocket-based real-time UX
  • Azure cloud platform experience
  • LLM observability and evaluation frameworks (LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, or similar) instrumenting AI pipelines to track faithfulness and relevancy, not just uptime


How our partner works:

Their development workflow is AI-native. They use Claude Code with 30+ specialist AI agents, CLAUDE.md project conventions, and a Design → Build → Review pipeline. Every feature goes through product design agents before coding and security + QA agents after. This isn’t optional it’s how they ship quality at speed with a small team.

  • Small team, high autonomy. You report directly to the Director of Data Engineering. Minimal process, maximum ownership.
  • Real data only. No mock data in any environment. APIs return errors when Snowflake is down, not fake arrays. Empty states say “not yet available,” not fake numbers.
  • Documentation as code. CLAUDE.md files, architecture docs, and API route docs are living documents that stay in sync with the codebase.
  • Quality gates. Security review + QA review after every implementation round. Non-negotiable.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to build production-grade AI products at the forefront of agent-driven technology.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Outbound Growth Hunter — Business Development Representative
description:
About Foundey

Foundey is a strategic UI/UX design agency specializing in supporting SaaS, AI, and tech

startups. Our mission is to help startups create user experiences that match their potential

through design that connects user behavior to business success. We partner closely with

founders to deliver high-impact design solutions — from MVP design sprints to full-scale product

interface design and UX audits.


The Opportunity

We're looking for a relentless, resourceful hunter who doesn't wait for leads to come to them.

You won't inherit a playbook — you'll write one. If you've built pipeline from scratch, found

decision-makers nobody handed you, and converted cold conversations into real opportunities,

this role is for you. Comfortable with ambiguity, energized by the chase, and sharp enough to

earn a founder's attention in three sentences or less.


You'll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and qualifying potential customers — primarily

founders and decision-makers in SaaS, AI, and tech companies. You'll play a critical role in

connecting innovative startups with design solutions that drive real business outcomes.


Key Responsibilities

• Identify and research potential clients within SaaS, AI, and tech startup ecosystems

• Source qualified leads independently using any channel that works — LinkedIn,

communities, events, cold email, social, referrals, or whatever creative approach you

invent. No channel is off-limits.

• Own the full top-of-funnel — from identifying a name to booking a call — without relying

on inbound or handed leads.

• Develop and test your own outreach experiments; own the results and iterate fast.

• Find creative angles to reach founders — conference attendee lists, community posts,

funding announcements, product launches — and turn them into booked conversations.

• Schedule and coordinate discovery calls for the sales or leadership team

• Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of opportunities

• Track activities and performance using CRM tools

• Continuously optimize outreach strategies based on results and feedback


Qualifications

• 3+ years of experience in sales, business development, or lead generation (preferably in

SaaS or agency environments)

• Proven ability to book meetings with cold prospects — share examples of creative

outreach that worked

• Experience with outbound prospecting and cold outreach

• A track record of sourcing your own leads, not just working a provided list

• Comfortable operating without a defined system — you build your own process, manage

your own time, and hold yourself accountable to results

• Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce)

• Self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working remotely

• English proficiency required (additional languages are a plus)


Nice to Have

• Experience selling design, product, or digital services

• Understanding of UI/UX design processes and product development

• Experience working with early-stage startups or founders


Why Join Us?

At Foundey, you will work to identify high-impact projects at fast-growing SaaS and tech

companies, helping shape the digital tools that empower businesses worldwide. Your

contributions will be significant in driving growth for the business, with outcomes of your efforts

making a clear impact. This is an opportunity to take the step in your career in a studio that

values innovation, ownership, and excellence.


This is not a role with rigid scripts or assigned lead lists. You'll have full creative freedom to find

and engage the right clients in whatever way works — we care only about results. If you've ever

felt constrained by a playbook, you’ll love working at Foundey.

title: Business Analyst – Financial Crimes / Process Engineering
description:
Business Analyst – Financial Crimes / Process Engineering

We are looking for a Senior Business Analyst with strong experience in Financial Crimes and Process Engineering to support transformation initiatives within a global financial services environment.

This role requires a professional who can work closely with Compliance, Operations and Technology teams to map current processes, design future-state operating models, document requirements and support the implementation of improved, controlled and audit-ready processes.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with AML, KYC, Sanctions , process discovery, process mapping, AS-IS/TO-BE design, functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, controls documentation and UAT support.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead workshops with Compliance, Operations and Technology stakeholders.
  • Map AS-IS processes and design TO-BE processes with focus on efficiency, control and regulatory alignment.
  • Gather, analyze and document business and functional requirements.
  • Create user stories, acceptance criteria, process rules and data rules.
  • Support backlog prioritization and dependency management.
  • Define KPIs, success measures and process improvement opportunities.
  • Support the design of controls and evidence required for audit and regulatory purposes.
  • Partner with data and technology teams to ensure data quality and accurate system integrations.
  • Support UAT, functional validation and go-live readiness.
  • Create and maintain process documentation, including process flows, SOPs, RACI and data lineage.
  • Facilitate alignment and decision-making between business and technology teams.

Required experience

  • 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst .
  • At least 2+ years of experience in Financial Crimes , such as:
  • AML
  • KYC
  • Sanctions
  • Transaction monitoring
  • Compliance operations
  • Experience with process engineering , process discovery and process optimization.
  • Hands-on experience mapping AS-IS and TO-BE processes .
  • Experience with BPMN or similar process modeling notation.
  • Ability to write clear functional requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Familiarity with controls, risk management, regulatory expectations and audit-ready documentation.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills across Compliance, Operations and Technology.
  • Experience supporting UAT, testing and go-live readiness.
  • Experience with Agile delivery and tools such as Azure DevOps, TFS, Jira or Confluence.
  • Advanced English for interaction with global teams.

Nice to have

  • Experience in financial services, banking, wealth management or consulting.
  • Six Sigma, Lean or process improvement certification.
  • Knowledge of data lineage, data quality and control frameworks.
  • Experience creating SOPs, RACI matrices and operational procedures.
  • Six Sigma Black Belt knowledge or certification.

Ideal profile

The ideal candidate is a Business Analyst with strong process improvement experience and real exposure to Financial Crimes . This is not a purely technical BA role and not a generic process analyst position. We are looking for someone who understands AML/KYC/Sanctions processes, can lead workshops, document requirements, map AS-IS/TO-BE processes, support UAT and help create controlled, audit-ready documentation.

title: Cross-border logistics BD Manager
description:
What You'll Do？

As BD Manager, you will own the full commercial cycle for UniUni's cross-border logistics business in your market (Brazil or Mexico):

  • Represent UniUni at industry events, e-commerce conferences, and seller community gatherings.


What We're Looking For？

  • 6+ years of experience in B2B sales / business development within cross-border logistics, e-commerce fulfillment, last-mile delivery, or international freight forwarding .

title: Senior Advanced Analyst
description:

title: Consultor de Vendas-Soluções de Eletrodomésticos Comerciais
description:
1) Sobre a SolutionMall

A SolutionMall é uma plataforma global B2B de entrega de soluções, atendendo demandas de infraestrutura, indústria, hotelaria, varejo, facilities comerciais e compras baseadas em projetos.

Diferente das plataformas tradicionais focadas apenas na venda de produtos, a SolutionMall concentra-se na entrega estruturada de soluções , incluindo:

  • Esclarecimento de requisitos do cliente
  • Seleção de produtos adequados
  • Correspondência entre demanda e solução
  • Coordenação com fornecedores
  • Suporte em cotações
  • Acompanhamento de oportunidades e projetos

Na área de soluções para eletrodomésticos comerciais , a SolutionMall atende uma ampla gama de produtos e sistemas utilizados em hotéis, restaurantes, supermercados, hospitais, lavanderias, edifícios comerciais e instalações públicas.

Nossa cobertura de soluções pode incluir:

  • Máquinas de lavar e secadoras comerciais
  • Equipamentos para lavanderias self-service
  • Refrigeradores comerciais e expositores refrigerados
  • Equipamentos de refrigeração para supermercados
  • Expositores de bebidas
  • Displays comerciais e sinalização digital
  • Aquecedores de água para hotéis e aplicações comerciais
  • Lava-louças comerciais e equipamentos de limpeza
  • Equipamentos para cozinhas industriais
  • Ar-condicionado comercial e sistemas de ventilação
  • Sistemas de exaustão para cozinhas
  • Sistemas de renovação de ar
  • Pias, áreas de lavagem, bancadas e equipamentos auxiliares em aço inoxidável
  • Pacotes integrados de eletrodomésticos comerciais para hotéis, restaurantes, supermercados, hospitais, lavanderias e facilities

2) Visão Geral da Função

Estamos procurando um Representante Comercial – Soluções de Eletrodomésticos Comerciais para apoiar o desenvolvimento dos negócios da SolutionMall no Brasil.

Esta é uma função flexível, baseada em cooperação comercial, adequada para profissionais que possuam recursos locais de clientes, relacionamento com canais, distribuidores, integradores, empreiteiros ou experiência em desenvolvimento de negócios nos seguintes setores:

  • Eletrodomésticos comerciais
  • Equipamentos para hotéis
  • Equipamentos para restaurantes
  • Equipamentos para supermercados
  • Equipamentos de lavanderia
  • HVAC
  • Cozinhas industriais
  • Refrigeração comercial
  • Fornecimento de equipamentos para facilities
  • Distribuição B2B de equipamentos

O foco principal da função é desenvolver oportunidades locais, identificar demandas reais de compra, apoiar o desenvolvimento de RFQs e ajudar a SolutionMall a promover soluções comerciais no mercado brasileiro.

Temos interesse especial em candidatos que compreendam a diferença entre equipamentos de uso comercial e eletrodomésticos residenciais comuns .

O candidato ideal deverá apoiar atividades como:

  • Desenvolvimento de clientes
  • Comunicação com canais e distribuidores
  • Acompanhamento de oportunidades de projeto
  • Coordenação de RFQs e cotações
  • Promoção de soluções de eletrodomésticos comerciais
  • Coleta de feedback do mercado local
  • Coordenação comercial
  • Suporte ao avanço de projetos

Esta não é uma função de venda no varejo de eletrodomésticos residenciais. Trata-se de uma função de desenvolvimento de negócios B2B , focada em equipamentos comerciais, projetos e aplicações de uso contínuo e profissional.

3) Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver oportunidades locais de clientes e canais no Brasil, incluindo hotéis, restaurantes, supermercados, hospitais, lavanderias, edifícios comerciais e projetos de facilities.
  • Promover soluções de eletrodomésticos comerciais, como equipamentos de lavanderia, refrigeração, cozinhas industriais, lava-louças, aquecedores de água, displays, HVAC, exaustão e sistemas de ventilação.
  • Acompanhar necessidades dos clientes, RFQs, cotações, seleção de produtos e progresso dos projetos.
  • Coordenar a comunicação entre clientes, equipe da SolutionMall, fornecedores, distribuidores e contatos de projeto.
  • Compartilhar feedback do mercado brasileiro sobre tendências de demanda, preços, concorrentes, hábitos de compra e oportunidades de canais.

4) Qualificações

  • Mais de 2 anos de experiência em eletrodomésticos comerciais, equipamentos para hotéis, restaurantes, supermercados, refrigeração, lavanderia comercial, cozinhas industriais, HVAC, ventilação ou vendas B2B de equipamentos.
  • Familiaridade com equipamentos de uso comercial e capacidade de compreender necessidades dos clientes, seleção de produtos, acompanhamento de RFQs e coordenação de cotações.
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação e habilidade para desenvolver clientes locais, distribuidores, empreiteiros, integradores ou contatos de projeto no Brasil.
  • Experiência com hotéis, restaurantes, supermercados, lavanderias, empresas de facilities ou distribuidores de equipamentos será considerada um diferencial.
  • Recursos existentes de clientes ou canais no Brasil serão uma forte vantagem.
  • Inglês profissional para comunicação de negócios será considerado um diferencial.
  • Português fluente é necessário para comunicação local no Brasil.

5) Modelo de Trabalho

Esta função segue um modelo flexível de cooperação em desenvolvimento de negócios.

As principais áreas de atuação incluem:

  • Desenvolvimento de clientes
  • Acompanhamento de RFQs e cotações
  • Comunicação sobre produtos e soluções
  • Desenvolvimento de canais
  • Feedback do mercado local
  • Suporte ao avanço de projetos

Para candidatos adequados, a SolutionMall poderá oferecer oportunidades de cooperação regional de longo prazo, com base em recursos de clientes verificados, progresso dos projetos e contribuição comercial real.

6) Benefícios da Cooperação

A SolutionMall oferece um modelo de cooperação vinculado ao desempenho e à contribuição comercial real, incluindo:

  • Desenvolvimento de clientes
  • Criação de oportunidades qualificadas
  • Avanço de RFQs
  • Desenvolvimento de canais
  • Progresso de projetos
  • Resultados de pedidos e negócios

Os termos detalhados de cooperação poderão ser discutidos durante o processo de entrevista, de acordo com a experiência do candidato, recursos de clientes, capacidade regional e contribuição para projetos.

title: Consultor(a) Funcional Salesforce - Pleno
description:
Consultor(a) Funcional Salesforce (Sales & Service Cloud)

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.


Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?


Qual será o seu papel?

Como consultor Funcional, você atuará como Key User funcional especializado em Salesforce Sales Cloud e Service Cloud, sendo a ponte entre o time comercial (vendas e atendimento) e as áreas técnicas de TI. Seu principal objetivo é garantir a correta utilização da plataforma, aumentar a produtividade dos usuários, traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos funcionais e apoiar a evolução contínua dos processos de CRM, sempre com foco na experiência do cliente e na eficiência operacional.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Apoiar usuários comerciais no uso diário do Salesforce, tirando dúvidas, resolvendo problemas de navegação e promovendo boas práticas.
  • Executar atividades operacionais relacionadas a processos de vendas (ex.: criação e acompanhamento de oportunidades, leads, contratos) e atendimento (casos, resolução de solicitações).
  • Detalhar requisitos de negócio junto aos times de vendas, marketing e serviços, transformando demandas em especificações funcionais claras para o time técnico.
  • Validar soluções funcionais antes da liberação em produção, realizando testes de aceitação (UAT) em Sales Cloud e Service Cloud.
  • Homologar novas funcionalidades, fluxos e relatórios, garantindo que atendam aos critérios de negócio e qualidade.
  • Identificar gargalos e melhorias nos processos comerciais e de relacionamento com clientes, propondo ajustes na configuração ou no uso do sistema.
  • Participar de rituais ágeis (daily, review, planning) com o time de CRM, trazendo a visão do negócio.
  • Criar e manter documentação de suporte, manuais e treinamentos para usuários finais.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Experiência prática comprovada em Salesforce Sales Cloud e Service Cloud (mínimo 2 anos atuando como key user, analista funcional ou consultor).
  • Conhecimento sólido de processos de vendas , CRM e atendimento ao cliente (ex.: ciclo de leads, oportunidades, casos, SLAs).
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos funcionais claros e testáveis.
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita para interagir com usuários negócio e times técnicos.
  • Visão de processo e pensamento analítico para identificar melhorias e resolver problemas.

title: Technical Business Analyst – FIX Protocol / Trading Applications
description:
Technical Business Analyst – FIX Protocol / Trading Applications

We are looking for a Technical Business Analyst with strong experience in FIX Protocol and trading applications to support technology initiatives within a global financial services environment.

This role requires a professional who can work closely with business stakeholders, product teams, application development teams and vendors to gather, analyze, document and validate business and technical requirements for trading-related systems.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with SQL queries, UNIX log analysis, functional specifications, data flows, system integrations and UAT support .

Key responsibilities

  • Gather, analyze and document business, functional and technical requirements for trading applications.
  • Work closely with business stakeholders, developers, vendors and product teams to define and validate technology solutions.
  • Create and maintain functional specifications, business rules, exception rules and process documentation.
  • Analyze system data across multiple platforms, including UNIX, FIX, Oracle, SQL Server and mainframe environments .
  • Perform SQL queries and UNIX log analysis to support requirements definition, issue investigation and validation.
  • Translate business needs into clear technical requirements for development teams.
  • Support data sourcing activities, validating data completeness from acquisition through report or system delivery.
  • Define and support testing requirements, test cases and UAT activities.
  • Conduct functional walkthroughs and obtain business sign-off.
  • Track project risks, defects, change requests and delivery status.
  • Support multiple projects or workstreams in parallel within the software development lifecycle.

Required experience

  • 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst or Technical Business Analyst .
  • Strong experience with FIX Protocol .
  • Experience working with trading applications or capital markets platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with SQL queries .
  • Experience with UNIX log analysis .
  • Ability to write clear functional and technical requirements.
  • Experience creating FSDs , business requirements, test cases and UAT documentation.
  • Good understanding of system integrations, data flows and application troubleshooting.
  • Ability to translate technical concepts to business stakeholders and business requirements to technical teams.
  • Experience working with developers, vendors, product managers and business SMEs.
  • Advanced English for communication with global teams.

Nice to have

  • Experience in financial services, brokerage, investment banking, wealth management or capital markets.
  • Knowledge of Oracle, SQL Server or mainframe environments.
  • Experience with data governance standards.
  • Experience leading small projects or coordinating workstreams.
  • Experience working in Agile or hybrid delivery models.

Ideal profile

The ideal candidate is not a purely functional BA. We are looking for a hands-on Technical Business Analyst who understands trading systems, can analyze FIX messages, read UNIX logs, write SQL queries, document requirements clearly and work directly with both business and technology teams.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

title: Institutional Relations Manager
description:
Founded in 1948, Karadeniz Holding is a visionary industry leader that focuses on innovation while supporting growth with an emphasis on economic and environmental sustainability across a wide range of industries, primarily energy and shipbuilding.

Operating in more than 20 countries, with over 3,000 employees from 30 different nationalities and an installed capacity exceeding 8,000 MW, the Group generates reliable and clean electricity across four continents through its fleet of 45 PowershipsTM and 11 LNG vessels, providing employment to more than 10,000 people worldwide. Karadeniz Holding manages its PowershipTM fleet under its international brand Karpowership, meeting between 10% and 100% of the electricity needs of the countries where it operates across Europe, Africa, the Americas, and Asia. With high-capacity energy solutions, including PowershipTM, land-based plants, and floating LNG infrastructure, Karpowership supports countries and companies in their energy transition processes.

We are looking for an Institutional Relations Manager to join our operations in Brazil, based at our Rio de Janeiro office.

WHAT DO WE EXPECT?

• Bachelor's degree in Law, Economics, Engineering, Business Administration or related fields; postgraduate degree or MBA will be considered a plus,

• Minimum of 8 years of experience in institutional, governmental, or regulatory affairs, preferably within the energy sector (power generation, natural gas, oil & gas, or infrastructure),

• Strong knowledge of the Brazilian regulatory environment, especially in the electricity and natural gas sectors, including interaction with entities such as ANEEL, ONS, and MME,

• Proven experience in managing relationships with key stakeholders (government, regulators, associations, and institutional partners),

• Advanced English (spoken and written),

• Strong communication, negotiation, and influencing skills in complex and multicultural environments,

• Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret regulatory scenarios and anticipate risks and opportunities,

• Leadership skills, project management capabilities, and ability to work cross-functionally,

• Ability to work under pressure, manage multiple priorities, and handle strategic topics,

• High ethical standards and alignment with compliance and corporate governance practices,

• Proactive profile with autonomy and ability to develop strategic and innovative solutions.

WHAT AWAITS YOU?

• Lead and execute KPS Brazil's institutional and governmental relations strategy, ensuring alignment with business and regulatory objectives,

• Develop and maintain strategic relationships with government bodies, regulators, and industry entities, including ANEEL, ONS, MME, IBAMA, and other relevant stakeholders,

• Continuously monitor and analyze the regulatory and institutional landscape of the electricity and natural gas sectors in Brazil, anticipating risks and opportunities,

• Proactively represent and defend the company's interests in public consultations, hearings, and regulatory forums,

• Coordinate licensing processes, authorizations, and institutional interactions required for project implementation, operation, and continuity (including Powerships and onshore assets),

• Structure and implement stakeholder engagement strategies at local, regional, and national levels, including governments, communities, and strategic partners,

• Support institutional and contractual negotiations with public authorities and regulatory bodies, ensuring legal compliance and risk mitigation,

• Work closely with legal, regulatory, commercial, and operational teams to ensure consistency in the company's institutional positioning,

• Manage institutional crises and sensitive matters, ensuring effective communication and strategic positioning,

• Lead the preparation of strategic reports and executive analyses on the regulatory and institutional environment to support senior leadership decision-making,

• Represent the company in industry associations, chambers of commerce, and energy sector forums, strengthening KPS's institutional presence in Brazil,

• Ensure compliance with corporate governance, ethics, and compliance guidelines in all institutional interactions.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

• Hybrid working model,

• One day off on your birthday,

• Private health insurance (extended to dependents) and life insurance,

• Variable compensation package and performance-based bonus,

• Meal allowance + food allowance in line with market practices,

• Mobility benefits (transport allowance and parking policy),

• Well-being and quality of life programs, including TotalPass,

• Professional and personal training and development opportunities,

• Multicultural environment with exposure to international projects,

• Opportunity to contribute to strategic energy transition projects.

In line with our "One World" philosophy, we are adding success to our achievements with our colleagues, candidates, and all stakeholders. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all applicants, regardless of race, religion, language or gender and we crown our success with our diversity.

In accordance with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law – LGPD (Law No. 13,709/2018), we kindly ask you to review our Privacy Notice for detailed information regarding the processing of your personal data.

Identificar oportunidades e novas ferramentas para otimização da execução de projetos de TI e projetos corporativos, com análise de custo/benefício, comparação de eventuais soluções disponíveis no mercado em relação ao desenvolvimento/execução interna, implantar soluções definidas de acordo com as especificações funcionais e auxiliar na elaboração de prazos e orçamentos definidos.

Atribuições do Cargo

  • Auxiliar no desenvolvimento da estratégia corporativa para transformação na qualidade e prestação de serviços providos pela área de TI para os usuários internos e externos, no alinhamento das metas e objetivos definidos pela área de TI com as metas corporativas;
  • Auxiliar na elaboração de "roadmap" para execução de projetos do ponto de vista técnico de TI, seguido de elaboração e execução de plano de ação;

  • Identificar, viabilizar a implementação e gerenciar soluções de tecnologia internas e/ou externas para aumentar a eficácia e eficiência operacional, qualidade dos serviços e nível de governança da seguradora, de acordo com as necessidades identificadas/reportadas;
  • Gerenciar, em conjunto com o coordenador da área, o desenvolvimento da infraestrutura, da implantação e atualização de sistemas, softwares e de soluções de tecnologia;
  • Atender demandas do CEO, COO e do CIO e demais diretores quando solicitado;
  • Aplicar processos e políticas de governança da empresa e contribuir com melhorias;
  • Planejar, documentar, executar e testar estratégias e procedimentos de contingências, visando a segurança de dados e informações;
  • Auxiliar nas atividades de auditorias e continuidade dos serviços;
  • Manter monitoramento, avaliação de desempenho e qualificação das equipes, visando a manutenção da motivação, a fim de obter os melhores resultados das atividades da área e a busca pelas melhores soluções técnicas;
  • Buscar tendências de mercado e necessidades identificadas na seguradora para evolução tecnológica dos serviços e soluções ofertados ao mercado;

  • Cumprir o orçamento anual previsto para a área de TI;
  • Gerenciar as interações com os provedores de soluções externas;
  • Participar de reuniões periódicas com a Diretoria de TI;
  • Produzir relatório mensal demonstrando resultados, incidentes e monitoramento das atividades em andamento;
  • Garantir integração de produtos e sistemas;
  • Auxiliar na validação de soluções técnicas;
  • Auxiliar na gestão, revisão e conclusão de pontos de auditorias;
  • Analisar e propor melhorias em relação a indicadores de ocorrências;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento de normas e padrões;
  • Acompanhar o processo de homologação de equipamentos e softwares de soluções externas visando a transformação e inovação;
  • Conduzir reuniões com equipes de trabalho;
  • Auxiliar no desenvolvimento e implementação de workshops e treinamentos voltados para a fomentação da transformação & inovação no âmbito da seguradora.

Requisitos

  • Experiência mínima de seis (6) anos como Gerente de TI, com atuação comprovada em infraestrutura, redes e suporte (Service Desk), sendo desejável experiência no setor de seguros;
  • Vivência em projetos de transformação e simplificação digital de processos, gestão de mudanças e operações em seguros;

  • Domínio de ferramentas de ITSM (exp. Freshservice, ServiceNow).

Nível de instrução

  • MBA, Especialização ou Pós-Graduação em Gestão de TI, Transformação & Inovação e/ou áreas afins.

title: Billing Analyst
description:
About the Role We are hiring a Billing Analyst (Contracts & Invoicing) to support a high-volume, enterprise B2B billing operation within the telecommunications industry. This role owns the contractual and invoicing control stages of the Order-to-Cash process, acting as a quality, compliance, and accuracy gate between approved Purchase Orders and customer invoices. The position requires strong ERP execution, billing governance, and cross-functional organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute and control the Contracts & Invoicing stages of the Order-to-Cash process.
  • Validate sales orders and invoices against Purchase Orders (POs), contracts, pricing references, and billing structures.
  • Create, update, and validate Sales Orders in ERP systems.
  • Prepare and review invoice drafts, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and audit readiness.
  • Manage invoice issuance, correction, and cancellation workflows with full traceability.
  • Register invoices and supporting documentation in official repositories.
  • Submit or share invoices through customer portals and approved channels.
  • Coordinate with Sales, Contracts, Projects, PMO, Warehouse, and Finance to obtain required billing inputs.
  • Track invoice status, blockers, aging, and SLAs, ensuring disciplined follow-up.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Law, or related fields. Experience in Billing, Invoicing, Contract Administration, or Revenue Operations.
  • Strong knowledge of Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes.
  • Hands-on experience with ERP systems (TOTVS Protheus highly desirable).
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (controls, reconciliations, reporting).
  • Working knowledge of indirect taxation and invoice compliance.
  • Professional proficiency in English.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in telecommunications, infrastructure, or technology services.
  • Exposure to enterprise or Tier-1 customers.
  • Familiarity with invoice submission portals, acceptance workflows, and billing SLAs.
  • Experience operating in high-volume, month-end driven environments.

Our compensation package:

- Contract as Brazilian Labor Laws (CLT).

- Profit Sharing.

- Transportation vouchers.

- Meals vouchers.

- Health and Dental insurance.

- Birthday day off.

- Gympass / Totalpass.

If you see yourself in this position and would like to become a part of ZTE group, please apply sending you resume in English version. We look forward to hearing from you!

Aqui, cada pessoa tem voz, espaço e responsabilidade na construção do que fazemos. É assim, todos os dias, que nos tornamos o maior Grupo de Moda da América Latina.

Sua missão é garantir que a adoção de AI na empresa aconteça de forma estruturada, escalável e orientada a impacto, conectando as iniciativas descentralizadas das áreas com a estratégia global e promovendo consistência na forma como AI é aplicada no negócio.

title: Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician
description:
Job Description

Job Title: Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician

Location: Remote position in Brazil with in-person client visits as required

Reports to: Account Manager and CTO

Contract Type: CLT

About LG Sonic: LG Sonic is a global leader in sustainable water quality management, dedicated to developing cutting-edge technologies that help protect water ecosystems. With operations in over 50 countries, we specialize in advanced solutions for algae control, water quality monitoring, and environmental protection. Our award-winning ultrasonic technology, combined with real-time data monitoring, empowers industries, municipalities, and governments to maintain clean and healthy water bodies while reducing chemical use. At LG Sonic, we foster a dynamic and innovative work environment, driven by a passion for sustainability and technological excellence. Join our team and be part of a mission to create cleaner water for future generations.

Position Summary:

The Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician will be responsible for assembling, installing, and maintaining LG Sonic equipment at our clients' sites across various locations in Brazil. In addition to on-site technical duties, the professional will work remotely in an after-sales capacity, providing direct support and maintaining close communication with clients to ensure their needs are met effectively.

Position duties and responsibilities:

  • Assemble and install LG Sonic equipment at client locations throughout Brazil, ensuring proper setup and functionality.
  • Perform routine maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs on installed equipment to guarantee optimal performance.
  • Travel to client sites as needed to address technical issues and provide on-site support.
  • Provide remote after-sales support, responding to client inquiries, offering technical guidance, and resolving issues via phone, email, or other communication platforms.
  • Maintain direct and proactive communication with clients to ensure satisfaction and address their needs effectively.
  • Document all assembly, maintenance, and support activities, preparing detailed reports for internal records and client follow-ups.
  • Collaborate with the LG Sonic team to identify opportunities for equipment improvements or upgrades based on client feedback and field observations.
  • Adhere to safety protocols and company standards during all on-site and remote activities.

Qualification and requirements:

  • Must reside in Brazil and be willing to travel frequently to client sites across the country with flexibility to adapt to varying schedules.
  • Excellent communication skills in Portuguese and English (written and spoken) for client interactions, technical support, and reporting.
  • Proven experience in equipment assembly, installation, and maintenance, preferably in a technical or industrial setting.
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently in the field and remotely, with strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Familiarity with remote support tools and basic computer skills for documentation and communication.
  • Valid driver's license and ability to operate safely in diverse working environments.
  • Previous experience in after-sales or customer support roles is a plus.

Why Join LG Sonic? At LG Sonic, we offer an exciting and collaborative work environment where your contributions directly impact our mission of environmental sustainability and innovation. By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to grow professionally while being a part of a global leader in water treatment technology. We believe in investing in our people and fostering an inclusive culture where every team member's ideas are valued.

LG Sonic Values: Unity, Trust, Positivism, Over deliver and Passion.

Application Process: If you are interested in joining LG Sonic, we encourage you to apply by following these steps:

  • Submit Your CV: Please send your updated CV in English to with the subject line: Assembly and After-Sales Support Technician.
  • Apply via Recruitment Platforms: You may also apply through recruitment websites where this position is posted. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English.
  • Application Review: Our HR team will carefully review all applications and contact shortlisted candidates for the next steps.
  • Interview Process: Selected candidates will be invited for interviews to assess their skills, experience, and suitability for the role.

title: Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo
description:
Mackay Marine é uma empresa global de serviço eletrônicos marítimos com mais de 450 funcionários em 45 depósitos de serviços em 17 países, incluindo Américas, Europa, África e Ásia. Por mais de cinquenta (50) anos, a Mackay vendeu, instalou e atendeu equipamentos de navegação e comunicação a bordo de navios comerciais e navais, iates e embarcações de recreio. A Mackay garante o sucesso de nossos funcionários investindo em treinamento contínuo na fábrica e fornecendo todas as peças, suporte técnico e administrativo necessários. Também oferecemos salários competitivos, horas extras, benefícios e oportunidades de crescimento com base no mérito.

A Mackay Marine Brasil atualmente tem vagas em nossas localidade do Rio para Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo com experiência, habilidades e qualificações abaixo. Mackay se originou e está sediada nos EUA, é necessário ter proficiência em falar, ler e escrever em inglês.

Resumo do Trabalho de Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo:

Sob supervisão limitada, os Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo (MST) instalam, fazem manutenção e reparam equipamentos eletrônicos marítimos a bordo de navios comerciais e navais, iates e embarcações de recreio. Eles testam, ajustam e solucionam problemas de componentes, PCBs, subconjuntos e antenas, bem como carregam, atualizam e modificam o software. Os Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo utilizam seus conhecimentos de teoria e circuitos eletrônicos para resolver uma variedade de problemas técnicos, bem como para fazer uso inteligente de esquemas complexos, projetos e manuais para realizar tarefas com precisão. Após a conclusão de cada trabalho, o técnico redigirá e enviará um relatório de serviço detalhado.

Tipos de equipamentos atendidos:

• Radares

• ECDIS

• Satcoms

• Rádios HF e VHF

• GPS

• Girobússola

• Pilotos automáticos

• Sirenes

Qualificações do Técnico em Marítima:

• Mais de 3 anos como MST na indústria de transporte marítimo comercial.

• Um diploma universitário em engenharia ou certificações técnicas equivalentes.

• Proficiente em falar, ler e escrever em inglês.

• Forte conhecimento de teoria e aplicação de eletrônica.

• Licença de Operador de Rádio GMDSS preferencialmente.

• Fisicamente apto. O ambiente de trabalho geralmente envolve carregar 20 quilos, subir escadas/mastros, trabalhar em espaços confinados e exposição ao clima.

Os candidatos devem estar legalmente autorizados a trabalhar no Brasil.

title: Desenvolvedor .NET Sênior
description:

Descrição da vaga

SOBRE A AXIA ENERGIA

A Eletrobras agora é AXIA Energia e chega como a maior empresa de energia renovável do Hemisfério Sul, responsável por 17% da capacidade de geração nacional e 37% das linhas de transmissão do Sistema Interligado Nacional (SIN).

Com presença em todas as regiões do país, nosso foco é oferecer soluções completas que catalisem resultados, impulsionando o desenvolvimento do setor e transformando energia em oportunidades para pessoas, negócios e para o planeta.

Na AXIA Energia, o futuro é movido pela potência de quem acredita em transformar. Venha viver o novo com a gente!

ATENÇÃO: A AXIA Energia não cobra taxas para realização de testes, exames ou participação no processo seletivo.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Contract Manager para realizar a gestão estratégica de um portfólio de contratos pertencentes a um ou mais Projetos de Capital da empresa, dentro da Vice-Presidência de Engenharia. A atuação se dará durante todo o ciclo de vida do contrato, atuando nos seguintes pilares:

  • Gerenciamento de riscos contratuais e de projetos;
  • Gestão de alterações contratuais (análise de mérito e valor para change order, Claim, back charge);
  • Gestão de conflitos (negociações, análise de cenários para tomada de decisão);
  • Gestão de registros;
  • Gestão das relações com as partes interessadas (internas e externas).

No setor de Engenharia, essa posição irá atuar na equipe do projeto, reportando-se aos Project Managers, atuando de maneira transversal entre as disciplinas nos projetos, com reporte duplo à Gerência Corporativa de Contratos e Riscos. A função atuará de forma integrativa, garantindo comunicação fluida e tomadas de decisão de forma multidisciplinar.

Objetivo estratégico: melhorar a previsibilidade e assertividade dos resultados dos projetos em questão, através da prevenção de desvios contratuais e predição das tendências identificadas na gestão de riscos.

Responsabilidades:

  • Monitoramento e controle dos indicadores contratuais a nível contrato e projeto;
  • Gestão/mediação de negociações e conflitos;
  • Zelar pelo cumprimento da governança e procedimentos de gestão de contratos e riscos;
  • Realizar reporting executivo em frequência adequada (indicadores, status de conflitos sob gestão da área, negociações pré-contratação, tendências identificadas em fase de implantação, etc).
  • Gestão de registros realizados através de instrumentos contratuais e de comunicação (RDO, atas, cartas, e-mails, relatórios), realizando análise dos registros, definição de respostas e casos prioritários.
  • Gestão de escopo, identificando potenciais desvios (técnicos ou contratuais), monitorando prazos, obrigações e responsabilidades das partes do contrato.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Formação superior em Engenharia, Administração ou afins;
  • Experiência sólida em gestão/administração de contratos e negociação;
  • Conhecimento e/ou experiências em gestão de riscos contratuais;
  • Habilidade de liderança, visão sistêmica, capacidade de comunicação com diferentes níveis, criação de sinergia entre grupos de trabalho.
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em Recife - PE

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento e/ou experiência envolvendo: gestão de disputas, arbitragens e/ou de projetos, formação de preço/orçamento, planejamento, gestão de custos;
  • Pós-graduação ou certificações em gestão de projetos (PMP, RMP, IPMA, CCM, etc.);
  • Experiência com projetos de transmissão;
  • Vivência em ambientes com cultura Lean e foco em melhoria contínua.

  • interface com escritórios externos;
  • análise jurídica das demandas, riscos envolvidos e cenários processuais;
  • apoio na definição e revisão de estratégias de defesa;

title: Senior Estimator
description:
Company Overview:

Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we've forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably.

For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries.

Job Overview:

The Senior Estimator uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external issues to improve the estimating discipline within McDermott. They will act as a resource for colleagues with less experience and share their conceptual and practical expertise related to the estimating discipline. The Senior Estimator solves complex problems and uses their discipline-specific knowledge to improve their products or services. The Senior Estimator impacts a range of customer, operational, project, or service activities with the estimating team and other related teams and ensures that they are working within the appropriate guidelines and policies.

Job Responsibility:

  • Review, query, and understand the scope of work in order to prepare a proper estimate and direct attention to those areas that appear inconsistent or contain a high-risk element .
  • Support the PMT team to generate the Marine/Offshore Estimate for the Preliminary stage to ensure Bid No Bid.
  • Review the Project Plan along with the project planner and prepare subcontract scope packages for any work that is required to be subcontracted.
  • Gather information and input from functions with support from the Project Manager.
  • Consult with Subject Matter Expert (SME) to discuss Estimates and resolve issues.
  • Generate estimates with available Benchmark data and from experience prior to receiving the inputs from functions and evaluate the estimates received from functions against the internal estimate
  • Liaise with Project Team members plus all functional departments based on the specific functions allotted for a project, subcontractors and vendors, and Customer; including Procurement, Fabrication, Marine, Quality, HSES, Completions, and Welding Technology
  • Provide input to the Project Estimators, along with Basis of Estimate and Bench Markers
  • Give regular updates to the department manager/PMT /immediate supervisor and highlight any concerns about anything that might potentially jeopardize submitting a competitive proposal.
  • Analyze the cost components that are critical/crucial and seek quotes for applicable items.
  • Participate in Bid review meetings, estimate evaluation meetings, Risk assessment meetings, as well as any additional bid-related meetings, as required.
  • Prepare a comprehensive Basis of Estimate (BOE).
  • Review and identify contract price form.
  • Understand and clarify unit rate and lump sum breakdowns.
  • Accurately manage all the Previous Tender information and Treat it with Confidentiality
  • Utilize support from the benchmarking team (SMEs) by analyzing information on the costs from other similar projects and preparing the relevant benchmark report.
  • Attend and participate in Bid review meetings, estimate evaluation meetings, Risk assessment meetings, etc., as necessary for the Project/Department/Tender
  • Participate in HAZAN, HAZID, HAZOP, and other safety /operability/ reliability studies and workshops, as necessary for Project/Tender
  • Ensure any Risk or Opportunity highlighted is Duly captured for the Management review and approval.
  • Post Tender submission provide input for the clarification.
  • Support bid handover process ensuring proper transfer of pricing basis and critical assumptions to project team.
  • Manage own time to meet objectives; forecast and plan resource requirements.
  • Incorporate project planner input to develop the cost.
  • Assure that the estimate is:
  • Completed promptly
  • Cognizant of the Bid 'Win Strategy'
  • Aligned with planned schedeule
  • All the Risk and Opportunities highlighted.
  • With Due Basis of Estimate
  • Accurate, free of errors, omission, or hidden contingency
  • In line with the agreed execution plan
  • Evaluate and recommend ways to be more cost-effective or profitable

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or related technical discipline preferred. Equivalent experience will be considered.
  • Five plus (5+) years of experience in a large Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) company (preferably in Offshore/Marine Operations, and offshore estimation, ).
  • Subsea/SURF experience with Minimum 3–5 years of direct experience in subsea/SURF construction estimation, including deepwater pipeline installation, flexible/umbilical lay, subsea structure installation, and marine spread costs.
  • Experience with DSV, PLSV, and/or Heavy Construction Vessel (HCV) spread rate estimation strongly preferred.
  • Cost estimation experience, preferably in the Oil & Gas industry
  • Willingness to work overtime as necessary to meet deadlines
  • Intermediate level in Microsoft Office systems, e.g., Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Project
  • Accurately evaluate detailed specifications that are crucial to a cost estimator's success
  • Must pay attention to minute details because such details may impact a product's overall cost

Must plan their work and work efficiently and accurately.

We are looking for a Senior Engineer with strong .NET expertise and hands-on AI experience. In this role, you will build and deliver cloud-native applications while actively using AI tools and integrating AI capabilities into products.

If you enjoy building real products and working with modern technologies, we would be happy to hear from you.

title: Senior.Net Developer
description:
Job Title: Senior Software Engineer (Contractor)
